hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.go) gofmt -w "$f" 2>/dev/null; out=$(go build ./... 2>&1); if [ -n "$out" ]; then jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg r "$out" '{decision:"block",reason:("go build ./... failed after editing "+$f+":\n"+$r)}'; fi ;; esac; }

out=$( { go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...; } 2>&1 ); rc=$?; fmt=$(gofmt -l . 2>/dev/null); if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || [ -n "$fmt" ]; then { [ $rc -ne 0 ] && printf 'go build/vet/test failed:
%s
' "$out"; [ -n "$fmt" ] && printf 'gofmt needs to run on:
%s
' "$fmt"; } | jq -Rsc '{decision:"block",reason:.}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: go build && go vet && go test

hooks.command: if [ -n "$OPINIONATED_GO_LINT_TARGET" ] && [ -d "$OPINIONATED_GO_LINT_TARGET" ]; then bin=$(mktemp -t opinionated-go-analyzer.XXXXXX); go build -o "$bin" ./analyzer 2>/dev/null && count=$(cd "$OPINIONATED_GO_LINT_TARGET" && "$bin" ./... 2>&1 1>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); rm -f "$bin"; if [ -n "$count" ]; then jq -n --arg c "$count" --arg t "$OPINIONATED_GO_LINT_TARGET" '{systemMessage:("opinionated-go: "+$c+" findings against "+$t)}'; fi; fi
